name: Tooyama Kouji
source:
Yukari's brother and Kaori's husband. At first glance, a serious civil servant.

But he has a wild side when it comes to sex, and he brilliantly won over Kaori, who was drawn to that unexpected side!?

He dotes on Toshiya like a real younger brother, and even gives hands-on advice about his nighttime activities with Yukari?

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/A002/03_chara.html]official site[/url]]
